sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :-

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rahul Chaturvedi,J.

Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned AGA for the State.
By means of the present application, the prayer sought by the applicants is that to quash the charge sheet dated 26.01.2020 arising out of case crime no. 155 of 2019, under Section 498A, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P.Act, P.S.Vishnugarh, District Kannauj.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicants have already bailed out.
In view of the above submission made by learned counsel for the applicant, there is no eminent threat to be arrested.
If so advised the applicants may move discharge application and the court concerned shall decide the discharge application within a period of eight weeks from the date of institution.
